title: GovEagle adds opportunity duplication to the capture workspace
summary: Duplicate an opportunity in GovEagle so a second team can pursue the same solicitation in its own workspace, with the same details and files.
body_markdown:
You can now duplicate an opportunity so a second team can pursue the same solicitation in its own workspace.


## What changed


Sometimes two teams work one solicitation separately: a prime bid and a sub bid, or two business units chasing different lots. Until now the second team rebuilt the opportunity by hand. Now:


- **Starts where you left off.** The copy keeps the summary and overview, opportunity details, custom field values, stage, manager, due date and milestones.
- **You choose what comes along.** Pick which asset sources to copy, and adjust who the copy is shared with before you create it.
- **Still tied to the same notice.** Both copies stay linked to the same SAM.gov notice or source listing.


## Who it helps


Capture leads at firms that bid as both prime and sub, and business units pursuing different parts of the same vehicle.


## How duplicating an opportunity works


1. Click the **⋯** menu next to an opportunity, on the dashboard or inside it, and choose **Duplicate** .
2. Name the copy and review **Shared with** .
3. Under **Copy asset sources** , select the sources to include, then click **Duplicate** .


Get GovCon capture and proposal insights in your inbox.


## Where it fits


Duplication is part of[GovEagle's capture workspace](https://www.goveagle.com/solutions/bd-capture) .


## What it doesn't do


- **Work product isn't copied.** Proposal outlines, compliance matrices, tasks, notes and chat history stay with the original.
- **SharePoint sources aren't forked.** The copy connects to the same folder, so changes in SharePoint appear in both opportunities. Uploaded files are copied independently.
- **Salesforce-connected opportunities can't be duplicated.**
